review_description: The sales side was excellent nothing was a problem and arranged everything except the smart meters to be fitted. . However the installation term were very polite and nice however when the installation was carried out all seem  to be  good. But after inspection found all the damage which was done to  the sarking when wiring they just ripped the sacking open to gain access to run wiring instead of going into roof cavity to run wiring.
Polite, tidy and punctual. Excellent communication. Consultant came to home and we appreciated that.
